resources.string: Let it run in the background
Battery optimization pauses the connection while the phone sleeps, and can keep RexPocket from starting again after Android stops it.
Battery use is Restricted: Android stops RexPocket as soon as it leaves the screen. Set it to Unrestricted.
Data Saver keeps RexPocket off mobile data while it is away.
If your phone still stops it
Some phones stop apps on their own, beyond Android\'s settings. dontkillmyapp.com says what to change on yours.
Off, RexPocket lets this host go a minute after it leaves the screen, and connects it again when you come back.
Connects whenever RexPocket starts, also after a restart or a Disconnect, and stays connected in the background.
Android did not let RexPocket start again in the background. Open it to reconnect; Settings › Background and notifications shows what to allow.
